8 October 2026. This file is also reproduced line by line in the Excel workbook.

values: Valuation date 8 Oct 2026. USD millions unless stated.
Start at Overview; change the single case selector DCF!E5. Edit blue annual/stable assumptions, then review DCF, Sensitivity and individual reverse sheets.
USD millions for statements and value; million shares for denominator; USD/share for quotes; decimal rates with percentage formatting. FY:27 means year ending 30 June 2027.
All table rows are 24 pt. Narrative panels merge several 24 pt rows, so expanded explanations do not change table row geometry. Title rows are 30 pt.
Blue numeric inputs; green cross-sheet formulas; black same-sheet formulas. Dark navy identifies output labels. Notes are native Excel Notes, visible on hover or Review / Notes.

SBC is expensed inside operating profit and never added back. Finance lease assets are economic reinvestment; lease financing liabilities enter the bridge. Capitalized financing interest is removed from cash capex.
Normalized NOPAT = final revenue x (1+g) x margin x (1-tax). Required reinvestment = NOPAT x g / ROIC. Stable FCFF = NOPAT x (1-g/ROIC). Require WACC > g and ROIC > g.

Source Catalog and docs/source_crosswalk.csv identify original PDF, marked copy, one-based PDF page, conversion and Excel cells. Missing prior note disclosures stay n.a. Original PDF text is preserved.

Copy Python Code from C10 through the last code line to src/valuation.py. Keep the project data/processed folder beside src. Install requirements.txt then run python src/valuation.py --excel deliverables/Microsoft_DCF_ReverseDCF_Model.xlsx.

Python reads mapped numeric driver cells, not formula caches. Frozen annual source data and market-return history remain the evidence baseline. Manual changes to market-return history require a new source dataset.

Formulas use international Excel function syntax in XLSX and avoid TEXT-based commentary. Native What-If tables use actual inputs on their own DCF sheet. Excel Automatic calculation with data tables is needed after edits.

No peer prices or consensus estimates are invented. Exit multiple and triangular simulation are explicit analyst assumptions. Reverse one-factor tests are conditional and are not a complete operating capacity forecast.
